# Kling Avatar Official Avatar API Source Note

## Scope

- Source type: official Kling AI API reference for Avatar image-to-video plus official common authentication information.
- Captured for AIrchieve: image-plus-audio avatar video generation for `ai_provider.generate_lip_sync()`.
- This note records the integration contract and implementation implications; it does not copy complete vendor documentation.

## Key Product Facts

- Kling Avatar 2.0 generates lifelike dynamic avatar videos from a character image, speech content, and an optional avatar performance prompt.
- The character image acts as the avatar image and start frame.
- Speech content can come from uploaded audio or TTS-generated audio.
- The prompt can describe facial expressions, emotions, gestures, and action style.
- Official product materials emphasize long-content coverage, expressive motion, strong hand/action quality, lip sync, multiple character types, and multilingual examples.

## API Contract Used By AIrchieve

- Provider family: official Kling Avatar async image-to-video API.
- Base URL for China-region servers: `https://api-beijing.klingai.com`
- Submit endpoint shape: `POST /v1/videos/avatar/image2video`
- Status endpoint shape: `GET /v1/videos/avatar/image2video/{task_id}`
- Authentication: generate a JWT API token from AccessKey + SecretKey using HS256, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- Generation mode:
  - `std`: standard mode.
  - `pro`: higher-quality mode.
- Submit body:
  - `image`: avatar reference image, either Base64 without a `data:image/...` prefix or an accessible image URL.
  - `sound_file`: driving audio file, either Base64 or an accessible audio URL.
  - `audio_id`: alternative to `sound_file` for audio generated by Kling audition APIs; exactly one of `audio_id` and `sound_file` must be provided.
  - `prompt`: optional performance prompt.
  - `mode`: optional generation mode, default `std`; allowed values include `std` and `pro`.
  - `watermark_info.enabled`: optional boolean for generating a watermarked result.
  - `callback_url`: optional webhook URL.
  - `external_task_id`: optional user-defined task id; must be unique per user if provided.
- Submit response returns a `task_id`.
- Successful API responses use business code `0`.
- Poll response returns `task_status`: `submitted`, `processing`, `succeed`, or `failed`.
- Failed tasks expose the reason in `task_status_msg`.
- Succeeded tasks expose generated media in `task_result.videos`; the playable URL is `task_result.videos[].url`.

## Input Constraints

- The avatar image may be an HTTP/HTTPS URL or raw Base64 string without a data URL prefix.
- Image formats: `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`.
- Image size must not exceed 10 MB; width and height must each be at least 300 px; aspect ratio must be between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1.
- The driving audio may be an HTTP/HTTPS URL or raw Base64 string.
- Audio formats: `.mp3`, `.wav`, `.m4a`, `.aac`.
- Audio size must not exceed 5 MB; duration must be at least 2 seconds and no longer than 300 seconds.
- `audio_id` can reference only audio generated within 30 days and must also satisfy the 2-300 second duration range.
- Prompt length must not exceed 2500 characters.

## AIrchieve Implementation Notes

- `ai_provider.generate_lip_sync()` should remain provider-neutral and receive page-level `image_url`, `audio_url`, and an optional prompt derived from page content.
- AIrchieve currently maps page `image_url` to official `image`, page/segment `audio_url` to official `sound_file`, and `KLING_AVATAR_MODE` config to official `mode`.
- If upstream image or audio generation returns `data:` URLs, `creation` should persist them through [[asset-storage]] before calling Avatar because the current provider path passes URLs.
- The generated video URL should be written back to `CreationStoryboardPage.lip_sync_url`; when saving a book, this can populate `BookPage.video_url` and mark `lip_sync_status` as ready.
- Kling generated image/video URLs are cleaned after 30 days according to the official API response note, so production storage should persist the generated MP4 before exposing it as durable book media.
- For AIrchieve, the official Kling Avatar image-plus-audio API is the retained lip-sync path.

## Boundaries

- Kling Avatar 2.0 does not own AIrchieve `CreationSession`, `CreationStoryboardPage`, `BookPage`, or `Asset` records.
- The provider returns generated media references; ownership, persistence, moderation, and player payload assembly remain in `creation`, `asset-storage`, and `book`.
